title: Ghost kitchens
summary: Delivery-only kitchens running many virtual restaurant brands.
whyTempting: Delivery growth and lower rent than storefront restaurants.
whyItFails: Platform fees. Delivery apps take a large cut. No brand loyalty. Virtual brands are invisible and interchangeable. Quality issues. Food doesn't travel well and reviews suffer.
whatWouldChange: Own-channel ordering plus food designed specifically for delivery.

attempts.outcome: Closed sites and laid off staff in 2023
attempts.notes: Ghost kitchen landlord led by Uber co-founder Travis Kalanick.

attempts.outcome: Closed or sold all its kitchens and pivoted to software

reasons.detail: Platform fees: Delivery apps take a large cut.
No brand loyalty: Virtual brands are invisible and interchangeable.
Quality issues: Food doesn't travel well and reviews suffer.
